display_policy.interaction: comment mode click adds a comment; marker click opens tooltip/popover; edit is inline in popover
display_policy.teacher_guard: observation memo only; no trend/entry/simulation logic
display_policy.saved_hsi_interaction: right-click current HSI anchor to save; right-click saved HSI anchor to delete
display_policy.saved_vertical_interaction: right-click chart point/current sync line to save vertical marker; right-click saved vertical marker to delete
display_policy.saved_cycle_vertical_interaction: right-click chart point to add cycle vertical marker; right-click cycle vertical label to delete
display_policy.text_label_interaction: right-click chart point to add chart text label; click text label to edit/delete
display_policy.saved_hsi_teacher_guard: human visual hypothesis only; no trend/entry/simulation logic
